hero.title: Trade endless scroll for real life.
hero.subtitle: With Break, you retake control before you scroll — a Screen Time barrier between you and the feed.

problem.title: The problem
problem.lead: Endless scroll takes hours you never meant to give.
items: You open an app “for a second” and lose half an hour to the feed.
Notifications yank you out of work, study, or a conversation.
Late-night scrolling eats sleep before you notice.
Without a barrier, intention loses to the next swipe.

consequences.title: If nothing changes
consequences.lead: The cost is quiet — and measurable.
items: Less deep work; more half-finished days.
Worse sleep when the phone is the last thing you see.
People in front of you compete with a glowing feed.
Weeks pass with the same “I’ll fix it tomorrow.”

solution.title: The solution: Break
solution.lead: Authorize Screen Time, pick apps, Break blocks them. A challenge to open. A short session. Then it locks again. Your home screen shows real usage.

items.title: App blocking
items.text: Protected apps sit behind Apple Screen Time until you earn an opening.

items.title: Challenge before open
items.text: Sort balls, word search, three breaths, tile match, mahjong, flow, or a Bible verse — then you may open.

items.title: Short session + reblock
items.text: A limited unlock. When time is up, Break locks the app again.

items.title: Sleep Mode
items.text: After bedtime, protected apps stay blocked until morning.

items.title: Daily limit
items.text: A ceiling on openings. Hit it, and Break stops releasing apps for the day.

pro.title: Free vs Pro
pro.lead: Start free. Go Pro when one app isn’t enough.
items: Live hour — one free hour at once
Synced to your account · annual renewal

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Break Web collects the email you use to create an account and payment metadata required to fulfill Break Pro. We do not sell your personal data. Payment is processed by Stripe. For questions, contact support.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body: Break Pro is an annual subscription billed at $49.99 USD unless otherwise stated at checkout. Pro status syncs to the Break iOS app when you sign in with the same email. Refunds follow the payment provider policies applicable to your purchase.
